title: Is this just me or did this cert really expire?
description: A user on Reddit's r/cybersecurity subreddit reported that the SSL/TLS certificate for the website ic3.gov appears to be expired when accessed via Chrome on two different networks. No further technical details or vendor advisories are provided regarding this certificate expiration.
